ideas.title: Minnesota Nonprofit Fraud: A Deeper Look
ideas.description: Investigate the extent of fraud in Minnesota nonprofits and potential connections to other cases.
questions: What are the common patterns and schemes used in Minnesota nonprofit fraud?
How can oversight and accountability be improved?
ideas.insight: The Feeding Our Future fraud case is just one example of a larger issue in Minnesota nonprofits. Further investigation is needed to uncover the scope of the problem and potential connections to other cases.

ideas.title: LAUSD Investigation: What We Know
ideas.description: Summarize the current state of the FBI investigation into LAUSD Superintendent Alberto Carvalho and potential implications for the school district.
questions: What are the key findings of the FBI investigation?
How will the investigation impact the school district?
ideas.insight: The FBI investigation into LAUSD Superintendent Alberto Carvalho has led to his resignation, but many questions remain unanswered. Further analysis is needed to understand the implications for the school district and potential next steps.
